events.title: FDA approves Trikafta
events.detail: The elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor triple combination, for people with at least one F508del mutation.

events.title: FDA approves Alyftrek
events.detail: The once-daily vanzacaftor/tezacaftor/deutivacaftor triple, Vertex's next-generation CF modulator.

events.title: Canada pricing letter of intent for Alyftrek
events.detail: Vertex signed a letter of intent with the pan-Canadian Pharmaceutical Alliance, a step towards public funding in Canada.

events.title: FDA approves Vyjuvek
events.detail: Krystal's first approved HSV-1 gene therapy (for a skin disease). Its sales are what make Krystal profitable and fund KB407 for CF.
